capabilities: Build LLM scripts as Canvas DAGs using cards, arrows, colors, and prefixes
Run cannolis from the ribbon icon, command palette, or per-file .cno commands
Let LLMs read and write vault notes and send predefined HTTP requests
Build LLM chatbots with streaming and customizable formatting
Transcribe audio recordings with Whisper to trigger cannolis
extras: Full documentation website is still forthcoming; a walkthrough folder of sample cannolis is available in the plugin settings. Local Ollama use requires setting the OLLAMA_ORIGINS environment variable.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually build and run LLM automations that read and write vault notes or take actions on their behalf.

requires.name: OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, or Gemini API key

summary: No-code LLM script builder and runner that uses Obsidian Canvas files, with nodes and arrows for variables, loops, branching, and HTTP actions.
